response.sql:
WITH long_rental_films AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_rate,
    rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
),
per_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_duration,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM long_rental_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) AS benchmark_value
  FROM per_rating_avg
)
SELECT 
  pra.rating,
  pra.avg_rate_per_duration,
  pra.film_count,
  pra.avg_rate_per_duration / b.benchmark_value AS ratio_to_benchmark
FROM per_rating_avg pra
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE b.benchmark_value IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Treating 5 days as the cutoff for a long rental period means rental_duration >= 5 (includes 5 days and above).

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff could be an exclusive lower bound: rental_duration > 5 (includes only 6 and 7 days, excludes 5 days).
